# Synthetic face fixtures

These images are AI-generated fictional adults and do not depict real people.

- `known_person.png`: generated as a centered, front-facing, neutral adult East Asian man on a light gray studio background; used as “测试人员A”.
- `unknown_person.png`: generated as a distinct centered, front-facing, neutral adult East Asian woman on a pale blue-gray studio background; used only as the unknown-person negative sample.

Both prompts required exactly one person, no text, no watermark, no glasses, even lighting, and passport-style composition. Generated with OpenAI ImageGen on 2026-08-04 and visually inspected before use.
